channel.title: The Drill Down: Carolina Panthers
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Panthers at Buccaneers
item.description: Mon 11/30 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: TB -3 · O/U 43.5 | Model TB 46% vs. market 59% | The battle at the line decides this one, since Tampa Bay ranks 6th in stuff rate and needs its run game to work against a Carolina defense that ranks 20th at generating stops. Baker Mayfield sits at the bottom of the league under pressure, and Carolina's pass rush, ranked 19th, can reach him. Our model gives Carolina 54% against the market's 41%, a gap driven mostly by the starting quarterback.

item.title: Week 11: Ravens at Panthers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CAR -2.5 · O/U 43.5 | Model CAR 53% vs. market 57% | Baltimore needs chunk plays to beat a Carolina defense that ranks 4th in explosive plays allowed, and the Ravens' offense ranks 27th in creating them. Tetairoa McMillan draws 33% of Carolina's air yards, and Baltimore's 19th-ranked pass defense will decide whether that volume becomes production. Our model has Carolina at 53% against the market's 57%, and home field is the main factor pushing us that way.

item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 45% vs. market 50% | The fight in space decides this one: Carolina's defense ranks 1st in yards after catch over expected, while New Orleans' ranks 28th, so the Panthers must keep short throws from turning into chunk gains. Chris Olave soaks up 29% of New Orleans' targets and runs into a Carolina pass defense ranked 25th. Our model makes Carolina a 55% winner against a 50-50 market, driven chiefly by the rushing matchup.
